description: Returns portfolio allocation breakdown — current USD value grouped by a chosen dimension. Use this when the user asks: 'how is my portfolio split', 'allocation breakdown', 'what % is in crypto', 'chain breakdown', 'show my biggest position', 'concentration'.  Groups available:   - 'asset_class' (default): crypto / stock / prediction / cash (cash = stablecoins like USDC/USDT + fiat)   - 'connector':            bybit / metamask / polymarket   - 'account':              one row per configured account   - 'chain':                EVM chain (Ethereum / Polygon / etc.) — only meaningful for MetaMask holdings   - 'symbol':               BTC / ETH / individual market — best for top-N concentration analysis  Each group row includes: label, currentValue (USD), percentOfTotal, holdingCount. Sorted descending by currentValue.  Inputs:   - by: which dimension to group by (see above). Default 'asset_class'.   - top: limit to top N rows (e.g. top: 10 for biggest positions). Default no limit. Returns position data only. Not financial advice.

by.description: Dimension to group USD value by (default 'asset_class'). 'chain' is only meaningful for MetaMask holdings; 'symbol' is best for top-N concentration analysis.

top.description: Limit to the top N rows by value (e.g. 10 for biggest positions). Omit for no limit.

name: get_allocations
